sentences.en: Sami was in love with nothing more than an illusion.
sentences.zh: 萨米爱的其实只是一种幻觉。

sentences.en: Maria lost the ability to distinguish between reality and illusion.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚失去了分辨现实与幻觉的能力。

sentences.en: This looks longer than that, but it is an optical illusion.
sentences.zh: 看起来这个比那个长，但这只是光学上的错觉。

senses.zh: 错觉, 幻想, 错误观念 - 假象 形容词: illusionless

mnemonic: 词根记忆：il（进入）+lus（玩）+ion（表名词）→有被玩弄的幻觉→幻觉
